The lamp is made by filling a plastic bottle with water and chlorine, you know, the chemical that we use in swimming pools, and then you put it in a sunny place. It takes energy from the sun during the day and at night it lights up so you can use it as a lamp. People who live in places with no electricity can use these bottle lamps.
